```yaml
name: Lint and Roadmap Update

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install flake8 black isort

      - name: Lint with flake8
        run: |
          # stop the build if there are Python syntax errors or undefined names
          flake8 . --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
          # exit-zero treats all errors as warnings
          flake8 . --count --exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=127 --statistics

      - name: Lint with black
        run: |
          black --check .

      - name: Lint with isort
        run: |
          isort --check-only --diff .

  update-roadmap:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update roadmap with new tasks
        run: |
          # Define new roadmap content
          NEW_CONTENT="## Document Understanding Tasks
- Table structure recognition
- Key-value extraction
- Reading order
- Handwriting
- Scene text
- Document classification
- Multi-page context
- Figure/chart awareness

## Data Augmentation (SynthDoG)
- Realistic noise
- Complex layouts

## Modeling Additions
- Quantization recipes
- Confidence estimation
- Serving example
- ONNX/TRT export
- Data mixing strategy
- Experiment tracking

## Benchmarking Additions
- Robustness benchmarks
- Commercial API comparison
- Cross-dataset generalization
- CI regression testing
- Failure mode taxonomy
- Domain-specific benchmarks

## Developer Experience
- Unified CLI
- Tutorials
- Model cards
- Output format interop

## Priority Order (Impact)
1. Document Understanding Tasks
2. Benchmarking Additions
3. Modeling Additions
4. Data Augmentation (SynthDoG)
5. Developer Experience"

          # Append to existing roadmap file
          echo "$NEW_CONTENT" >> docs/roadmap.md

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add docs/roadmap.md
          git commit -m "Update roadmap with new tasks, benchmarking, and DX" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:main || echo "Push failed, likely no changes"
```
